actions.subject: Credit note request: invoice BG-2026-0318 price variance
actions.body:
Hello Wendell,

On invoice BG-2026-0318 (our ref AP-26-0056), line 1 (Roma tomatoes, 25 lb, 300 units) is billed at $19.85 per unit. Our PO PO-24076-1 price is $18.40. The difference is $435.00. We are paying the matched amount of $8,172.00 and ask you to issue a credit note for $435.00. If the PO price is out of date, please send us the supporting documentation.

Thank you,
Quillfeather Provisions Accounts Payable
